Type: long low TV console
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storage; living room, family room
Style: rustic, farmhouse
Materials: reclaimed solid pine, distressed finish, dark iron bar pulls
Colors: warm light natural wood, black
Shape: long low rectangle, overhanging plank top, open shelf with cable holes, four drawers below, thick corner posts with block feet, chunky and heavy
Feel: warm, sturdy, homey
Goes with: warm woods, cream walls, black iron accents, leather; rustic, farmhouse or lodge rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Ferndale Rustic Reclaimed Pine Media TV Console Stand, 71"W, Sandstone
product.description: 71"W x 18”D x 24”H Durable, sustainably sourced solid pine and metal Modern rustic with weathered natural finish Openings in the back make it easy to organize wires and cables Easy assembly in 15 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Made of solid reclaimed pine, this console will add a warm rustic touch to your home. Place a TV on top, gaming consoles on the lower shelf, and remote controls and cables in the four storage drawers. The natural wood grain makes each piece unique.
